free.label: Free Pick of the Day
free.plain: This product has made 864 picks since 2026-03-20. About 54 out of every 100 won. It wins more often than it loses, but the odds it takes are short enough that the wins do not cover the losses.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.plain: This product has made 22 picks since 2026-08-03. About 59 out of every 100 won. That has been enough to stay ahead so far.

syndicate.label: Syndicate Session
syndicate.plain: This product has made 141 picks since 2026-03-18. About 51 out of every 100 won. It wins more often than it loses, but the odds it takes are short enough that the wins do not cover the losses.

prizepicks.label: CER Props
prizepicks.plain: This product has made 97 picks since 2026-03-28. About 24 out of every 100 won. That is fewer than it needs to break even, so it is down overall.

ppme.label: Pull the Handle
ppme.plain: This product has made 141 picks since 2026-08-07. About 6 out of every 100 won. That is fewer than it needs to break even, so it is down overall.

provenance.note: 52 early picks were re-attributed on 2026-09-03 by matching them to the picker artifact that recorded them. Their source had named the module that wrote the row, not the picker. Picker records before that date changed as a result; the underlying ledger did not.
